{{Top|leg}}
A '''force-dome''' was a localized form of defensive [[Deflector shield/Legends|shielding]], created during the last decades of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] as a security system for remote outposts. The force-dome used a collection of crystals, similar to those used in the construction of a [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]], to generate a hemisphere of protective energy. Its size could be modulated by the amount of power and the number of crystals used, but was usually limited to a few square miles in surface area. The shield produced by the force-dome was capable of repelling even the heaviest of projectile weapons, but could eventually be pierced by ion-type weapons.
